newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds untraded in Buenos Aires.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds untraded in Buenos Aires.

text.p: Argentine local bonds were untraded Tuesday as many banks and brokerages shut their operations for Christmas.
A couple of trades were recorded on screens but all activity was expected to die down in the afternoon. "There is no activity today," said a trader.
The market will be shut on Wednesday and considering that a general strike has been called for Thursday, traders said there could well be virtually no activity for the rest of the week.
On Monday, the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 finished $0.30 higher at 122.85.
Argentina's Brady bonds traded abroad, meanwhile, were higher. The FRB due 2005 was 1/4 up at 86-7/8.
